#3 idol — THE DARK SCENE: ink flips to whiteOnBlack, circulation nearly sealed (0.06), dispersion 0.04 — the path through the image closing; ∴ (the forged provenance) answered by A32 arriving centre-bright (the genuinely disclosed relation entering the idol's field); repel/shove — contrary speech classified and thrown back; the longest beat before the return (14) — the closure held.

#5→0 return — THE 3D SCENE. z is the offices' distinct depth: A28 (the commission) nearest at z +0.3, ← the return at z +0.2, ΣΛΤ (Symbol/Account/Trust) deepest at z −0.3, the shared ring at z 0; the four-office walker (Avatar → Image → Mask → Idol → Regard) crosses the ring in z and its last station Regard arrives centre-bright — the ecology completing as regard; pointer attract/implode — the answer gathered back to the answerable form; auto-regard LFO on pointerStrength (answerable attention breathing).

ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0's descent (Avatar → a voice) presented presence entering form under repel — the meeting at a threshold; #5→0's walker re-enters those offices by name and ends at Regard, centre-bright, under attract/implode — the same form now one the bearer can answer and exceed; the ≡ of #0's role became #2's ⊢ internal verdict, and the idol's ∴ forged proof at #3 is answered by A32's disclosed measure — possession re-read as answerability. Withdrawal stays a possible answer: no office is revoked, each is re-situated (A27/A30; the tellings keep their homes).

Human-amplified guards carried: no attribution of the ecology to Sanskrit avatāra doctrine or icon-idol history; Jung's §§614–617 keeps its attributed office; the Fanonian seam held for its own source-bearing recovery (kicker); no prevalence or documented case established for the liar's dividend; seeming assent does not authorise consent. glyph_rationales.≡: the recognising measure — the role's expectations that render someone legible (#0); at #2 the field's measure the bearer must administer.
glyph_rationales.⊢: the internalised verdict — anticipating what will count: the measure become the bearer's own criterion (#2, self-administration).
glyph_rationales.◉: the interpreting agent — the functional knower whose selection can itself become known in a further inquiry (#1).
glyph_rationales.C38: the Bimba–Pratibimba map: the concept-anchor of the local-original relation (#1).

glyph_rationales.Bimba: the local original earned within a declared Context Frame — authority real at the scale of the inquiry, revisable by what comparisons return (#1).

glyph_rationales.∴: the forged inference — the counterfeit's seeming proof: this recording, therefore this event; fabricated provenance, not merely a false proposition (#4).
glyph_rationales.A32: the mirror that moves first — the genuinely disclosed relation: the instrument exposes its source, angle and measure before requiring conformity (#4, the counterfeit's contrary).
glyph_rationales.A28: authored ground and positional delegation — authority exact without absolute sourcehood; the entrusted commission inspectable and revisable (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.←: the return — what the image has done re-entering its source-field as a condition of its next use (#5→0).
